shortDescription: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions outlined four internal milestones for measuring progress toward breakeven, with monthly operating cash breakeven targeted for January 2027.Key Highlights:Original SEC Filing: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions outlined four internal milestones for measuring progress toward breakeven, with monthly operating cash breakeven targeted for January 2027.
The first milestone compares recognized monthly revenue with operating cash costs, excluding debt service and inventory purchases.
Monthly accrual operating breakeven is targeted for March–April 2027; targets for the two stricter debt-service and full-accrual milestones are unset.
The company plans to reduce monthly cash spending by more than $350,000 from February 2027 versus its August 2026 run rate.
Fiscal second-quarter revenue was $1,985,604, up 8% sequentially and 5% year over year; recurring device rentals were 89% of revenue.
The company cautioned the milestones are internal targets, not guarantees; it reported substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.
